units: Meg. 12ᵇ כלי … כשדיי the vessel which I use (my wife) is neither …, but a Chaldean.—Pl. כַּשְׂדִּים, כַּשְׂדִּיִּים.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 37:1">Pesik. R. s. 37</cite> <he>כשנפרע מן הכ׳</he> when the Lord punished the Chaldeans (Babylonia, v.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 21:2">Midr. Till. to Ps. XCIII, 1</cite>).—
Lam. R. to I, 14 כ׳ קשה the Chaldean government was tyrannical (contrad. to בבל); a. e.—Fem. כַּשְׂדִּית, pl. כַּשְׂדִּיּוֹת.
